component.name: Syspeek
component.summary: Always-on-top HUD for the focused app's CPU, RAM, Docker and Kubernetes status

description.p: Syspeek is a small, always-on-top panel that follows the window you are focused on and shows that application's CPU and memory usage, plus optional Docker and Kubernetes health.

ul.li: the focused app's name, PID, CPU percentage and resident memory
metrics aggregated across the app's whole process tree
Docker container health: unhealthy, restarting and recently exited
Kubernetes problem pods and deployments with too few ready replicas

description.p: Docker and Kubernetes integrations are optional and run off the UI thread, so a missing tool never blocks the overlay.
